# PSYCHO2.9 (Neeraj Tiwari)

> Cinematic portfolio of Neeraj Tiwari, aka PSYCHO2.9: video editor, Telegram bot builder, ethical hacker and web designer. High-retention edits, resilient bot systems and secure code.

## Pages
- [Home](https://your-domain.com/): single-page portfolio (skills, timeline, selected works, about, contact)

## What I do
- Video editing: high-retention cinematic edits, motion graphics, colour grading
- Telegram bots: async Python bots, moderation, automation
- Ethical hacking: Linux, security audits, hardened setups
- Web design: responsive, accessible, light/dark interfaces

## Selected works
- Timeless (Video Editing, 2025): High-pacing narrative cut featuring custom motion curves, dynamic speed ramps, and analog color grading in Adobe After Effects and CapCut.
- Game Engine Interface (Web Design, 2025): Dark-mode interactive interface engineered for ultra-responsive game controls, zero layout shift, and intuitive HUD layout.
- System Builder Platform (Ethical Hacking, 2024): Full-stack platform built with Linux server infrastructure, rate limiting, secure proxy routing, and automated penetration testing validations.
- Driven Motion Cut (Video Editing, 2024): High-energy short-form video edit synchronized to audio transients with custom typography animation and seamless match-cuts.
- Ideas Automation Bot (Telegram Bots, 2024): Telegram bot automating asynchronous content distribution, inline keyboard menus, custom state machines, and webhook dispatching in Python.
- Sound Synced Sequence (Video Editing, 2024): Audio-first cinematic showreel edit matching dynamic motion transitions to complex multi-track sound effects and sub-bass drops.
- Culinary Brand Film (Video Editing, 2023): Commercial promo film featuring macro food cinematography, warm contrast grading, stabilized tracking, and crisp sound foley.
- Travel Documentary (Video Editing, 2023): Atmospheric travel montage edited with fluid whip-pans, ambient soundscape design, and cinematic aspect ratio framing.
- Space & Cyberpunk Concept (Web Design, 2023): Dark atmospheric web showcase pairing futuristic typographic layouts with subtle CSS glow and tactile film grain.
- Play Interactive Canvas (Web Design, 2023): Experimental web interaction sandbox testing fluid mouse physics, canvas particle rendering, and accessible controls.
- Cleaner Utility Bot (Telegram Bots, 2022): High-throughput group moderation and cleanup Telegram bot featuring anti-spam regex filters, admin access control, and auto-delete timers.
- Security Steps Audit Tool (Ethical Hacking, 2022): Scripting toolkit automating network endpoint discovery, port scanning verification, and checklist report generation for web application assessments.
